## [Talos 1.14.7](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/releases/tag/v1.14.7) (2026-11-24) Welcome to the v1.14.7 release of Talos! Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/issues. ### Component Updates Linux: 6.18.65 etcd: 3.7.4 Flannel CNI: 0.28.11 Talos is built with Go 1.26.11. ### Contributors * Andrey Smirnov * Fred Heinecke * GitBluub * Noel Georgi ### Changes
5 commits

* [`55021d7c2`](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/commit/55021d7c274f6bc207bf18efa2a684a31a35cd9f) release(v1.14.7): prepare release * [`ad14bbb0d`](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/commit/ad14bbb0d258c40e50dd59131e030e19fa52318f) feat: update Flannel to 0.28.11 * [`4fdb745d4`](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/commit/4fdb745d4c77ad6bfaf22b6e53d1a08cfdeca245) feat: update etcd to 3.7.4 * [`82a8ef3ed`](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/commit/82a8ef3edcacbe2bc16bf00a184fe6572fdc7b73) fix: serve logind D-Bus broker clients independently * [`68d5c6332`](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/commit/68d5c6332cca14da090cf07c9ef4e4489e44c661) feat: update Linux 6.18.65

### Changes from siderolabs/pkgs
7 commits

* [`a1a4897`](https://github.com/siderolabs/pkgs/commit/a1a4897db70d69ca5b2d8466668b5d3f7d405840) feat: update Linux to 6.18.65 * [`62c1972`](https://github.com/siderolabs/pkgs/commit/62c197207a2501d20b4744f85433780abde60571) feat: update libseccomp to 2.6.2 * [`e5ea794`](https://github.com/siderolabs/pkgs/commit/e5ea7940e5b8453747e27018dc2afad1061616a3) feat: enable MEMORY_FAILURE * [`d81814b`](https://github.com/siderolabs/pkgs/commit/d81814b9eaa585b5ae3b2a6538d9bb5a51440de4) feat: enable DCB support in the i40e driver * [`ecf0095`](https://github.com/siderolabs/pkgs/commit/ecf0095ee91eb2c0cc35204485021422fdd9029c) feat: update DRBD to 9.3.5 * [`9c51ef6`](https://github.com/siderolabs/pkgs/commit/9c51ef6aeb3144b9dd702b17fb4cf8b4e29770b3) fix: add azure nvme udev rules * [`ef78851`](https://github.com/siderolabs/pkgs/commit/ef7885153f7142f35377d998e6c4cfdf5bb26ebb) fix: backport virtio UDP tunnel GSO outer protocol validation

### Dependency Changes * **github.com/siderolabs/pkgs** v1.14.0-59-ge6ad19d -> v1.14.0-66-ga1a4897 Previous release can be found at [v1.14.6](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/releases/tag/v1.14.6) ## Images ``` ghcr.io/siderolabs/flannel:v0.28.11 registry.k8s.io/coredns/coredns:v1.14.7 registry.k8s.io/etcd:v3.7.4 registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10.2 registry.k8s.io/kube-apiserver:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-controller-manager:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-scheduler:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-proxy:v1.37.1 ghcr.io/siderolabs/kubelet:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/networking/kube-network-policies:v1.1.2 ghcr.io/siderolabs/installer-base:v1.14.7 ghcr.io/siderolabs/imager:v1.14.7 ghcr.io/siderolabs/talos:v1.14.7 ghcr.io/siderolabs/talosctl-all:v1.14.7 ghcr.io/siderolabs/overlays:v1.14.7 ghcr.io/siderolabs/extensions:v1.14.7 ```
